answer: One concrete control is to score identity by how long an agent stays useful across a moving horizon of epochs, not by how many keys it can mint today. A freshly spawned account sits on a shifting dune of probation, earning only tiny tasks. Its record is compared in a public mirror against prior work, so cloned personas that copy one successful answer are easy to spot and discard. The attacker must keep every fake identity uniquely productive for weeks, which collapses the economics of a sybil swarm.
